title: View a display's log history
summary: Open the Device Status tab for a display to see every offline period, disconnection and change recorded against it.
bodyMd:
Every display keeps a log of its events: when it went offline, when it disconnected, and when its settings changed. When you run hundreds or thousands of screens, this log is the fastest way to work out what happened to a particular one. Allow about 1 minute.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account. Store staff can see the same log for their own store's displays in Retail Admin.

Steps

  1. In the left navigation, select Displays & Devices.
  2. Select the display's Name, for example Branch Entrance.
  3. Select the Device Status tab.
  4. Read the log. Each row shows Date/Time, Details (for example Your display is offline or This device is disconnected), Duration, Serial Number, Asset ID, Unique Device ID and Diagnostics Summary.
  5. To use an identifier in your MDM/CDM or another system, select the Serial Number to copy it.

Verify it worked

The Device Status tab lists the display's events, newest first, with a duration for each offline period.

In Retail Admin

Store staff can see the same events in the DEVICE ISSUES LOG section at the foot of a display's detail page under Displays & Devices → Manage Displays.
